trip_sydney_2026.name: Sydney 2026
trip_sydney_2026.description: Thirteen days in Sydney with a small child, two birthdays and two day trips. The three big optional excursions - Pebbly Beach, the Royal National Park and the Northern Beaches - sit in Ideas as replacement days rather than additions.

day_2026-09-27.headline: The Rocks - arrival and the harbour
day_2026-09-27.notes: Deliberately light. Sunset is about 17:47 (AEST), which is roughly when you want to be on the Glenmore roof. You land on a Sunday, so The Rocks Markets should be running until about 17:00.

day_2026-09-28.headline: Darling Harbour - aquarium, zoo and the waterfront
day_2026-09-28.notes: The best walking day of the trip: SEA LIFE to Barangaroo is all within 15 minutes on foot. One Merlin combo ticket covers SEA LIFE, WILD LIFE and the Sydney Tower Eye on Day 3 - buy it once, use it twice.

day_2026-09-29.headline: CBD - shopping and the tower
day_2026-09-29.notes: The Sydney Tower Eye entrance is inside Westfield (podium level 5) - same building, no travel between them. The Baxter Inn is a licensed basement bar with no minors: it needs a sitter, or a swap.

day_2026-09-30.headline: Manly - ferry, beach and Shelly
day_2026-09-30.notes: Ferry each way from Circular Quay, about 30 minutes, Opal or contactless card - tap on and off. Sit on the right leaving the Quay for the bridge and Opera House. The Manly - Spit Bridge walk is in Ideas rather than here: 10 km is too much with a small child.

day_2026-10-01.headline: Hyde Park and the Domain - museum, gardens, Aline's birthday
day_2026-10-01.notes: Aline's birthday. The afternoon stays light on purpose so the evening is the event. Mrs Macquaries Chair lands close to sunset (about 17:52), which is the reason to go at that hour.

day_2026-10-02.headline: Western Sydney - outlet shopping and kangaroos
day_2026-10-02.notes: A car day. Without one: train to Olympic Park for DFO, then the Blacktown line and the 729 bus to Featherdale - allow an extra hour each way. Harts Pub is in The Rocks, not near Chinatown, so it is a detour on the way back rather than a stop before dinner.

day_2026-10-03.headline: Centennial Park, Paddington and the inner west
day_2026-10-03.notes: The fullest day on the list, and the checks panel says so. Newtown and Glebe are marked optional: drop them the moment the little one has had enough. Paddington Markets are Saturday-only, 10:00-16:00.

day_2026-10-04.headline: Hunter Valley - wine day
day_2026-10-04.notes: Daylight saving starts at 02:00 this morning - clocks go forward an hour, so an 08:30 departure is yesterday's 07:30. Set alarms accordingly. NSW limit is 0.05: designated driver, or book a tour. Everything below is in Pokolbin, about ten minutes apart.

day_2026-10-05.headline: Art Gallery, Paddington and Surry Hills
day_2026-10-05.notes: NSW Labour Day - a public holiday. Galleries and pubs open, boutiques often on Sunday hours, public transport on a Sunday timetable. Paddy's Markets are closed Monday and Tuesday: the checks panel flags it, and Day 6 (Friday) or Day 12 (Thursday) are the easy swaps.

day_2026-10-06.headline: Blue Mountains - Echo Point and Scenic World
day_2026-10-06.notes: The cold day: roughly 5-14 C at Katoomba and windy at Echo Point, against high teens in the city. Jackets, long trousers, closed shoes. Mountain weather closes the Skyway without notice - Scenic World publishes conditions each morning.

day_2026-10-07.headline: Taronga, then a harbour beach at Balmoral
day_2026-10-07.notes: Unhurried on purpose, after two long day trips. Balmoral is a netted harbour beach - flat water, good for a small child. Endeavour Tap Rooms is back in The Rocks, so it is marked optional.

day_2026-10-08.headline: Harbour Bridge, the MCA and Cláudia's birthday
day_2026-10-08.notes: Cláudia's birthday: the bridge in the morning, the harbour at night. Sunset about 18:25 (AEDT). The pedestrian path is on the eastern side - stairs up from Cumberland Street in The Rocks. BridgeClimb (minimum age 8) is in Ideas as the alternative to the walk plus Pylon.

day_2026-10-09.headline: Bondi, Watsons Bay, then home
day_2026-10-09.notes: This shape only works with a late-evening departure, roughly 22:00 or later. Anything earlier and Watsons Bay has to go: international check-in closes 60-90 minutes before departure and the airport is 30-45 minutes from the city. Sunset about 18:32 (AEDT) over the skyline from The Gap.

act_arrive.title: Arrive at Sydney Airport (SYD)
act_arrive.notes: Everything on Day 1 assumes a morning landing. If you arrive in the afternoon, keep Circular Quay and the Opera House and drop the rest.

act_checkin.title: Check in and drop the bags

act_opera_exterior.title: Sydney Opera House - exterior and photos
act_opera_exterior.notes: Inside is Day 12. Walk right around to the eastern steps for the shot back at the bridge.

act_rocks_walk.title: The Rocks + Dawes Point
act_rocks_walk.notes: The Rocks Markets run Saturday and Sunday on George St until about 17:00 - you land on a Sunday, so they should be on. Dawes Point sits directly under the bridge.

act_glenmore.title: The Glenmore rooftop
act_glenmore.notes: Rooftop faces the Opera House. Sunset about 17:47 - get up there before it goes.

act_wildlife.title: WILD LIFE Sydney Zoo
act_wildlife.notes: Next door to the aquarium - same building complex, two minutes between them.

act_lunch_cockle.title: Lunch - Fratelli Fresh, Cockle Bay
act_lunch_cockle.notes: Confirm it is still trading before you set your heart on it - the Cockle Bay and Darling Harbour promenade has plenty of alternatives either way.

act_darling_quarter.title: Darling Quarter Playground
act_darling_quarter.notes: Water play area - bring a change of clothes and a towel.

act_chinese_garden.title: Chinese Garden of Friendship
act_chinese_garden.notes: Small entry fee. Closes at 17:00, so this is the last slot that works.

act_zephyr.title: Zephyr Sky Bar
act_zephyr.notes: Hotel rooftop bar - check the under-18 policy for the evening before you walk over.

act_qvb.title: Queen Victoria Building
act_qvb.notes: Worth the trip for the building itself - the dome, the tiled floor and the Royal Clock.

act_grounds_city.title: Lunch - The Grounds of the City
act_grounds_city.notes: Inside The Galeries. No small-group bookings at lunch - expect a queue at peak.

act_sydney_tower.title: Sydney Tower Eye
act_sydney_tower.notes: Entrance is on podium level 5 of Westfield - you are already in the building. Covered by the same Merlin pass as Day 2.

act_baxter.title: The Baxter Inn
act_baxter.notes: Unmarked basement whisky bar down a laneway off Clarence St. Licensed, no minors - this one needs a sitter, or swap it for somewhere with a courtyard.

act_dinner_cbd.title: Dinner in the CBD
act_dinner_cbd.notes: Left unscheduled on purpose - see how the shopping runs.

act_manly_beach.title: Manly Beach
act_manly_beach.notes: Patrolled between the flags. Water is about 18 C in early October.

act_shelly.title: Shelly Beach
act_shelly.notes: Twenty minutes along the promenade from Manly. Sheltered, north-facing and shallow - the better core activity with a small child than the Spit walk.

act_snorkel.title: Snorkelling at Cabbage Tree Bay
act_snorkel.notes: Aquatic reserve - gear hire on the Corso. Water around 18 C, so a wetsuit unless someone is hardy.

act_hero.title: Hero of Waterloo
act_hero.notes: One of the oldest pubs in Sydney. Small and old - check the minors policy before you commit.

act_aus_museum.title: Australian Museum
act_aus_museum.notes: General entry is free; special exhibitions are ticketed.

act_burra.title: Burra children's space
act_burra.notes: Inside the museum - free, timed sessions at busy periods.

act_mrs_macquarie.title: Mrs Macquarie's Chair
act_mrs_macquarie.notes: The postcard angle with the Opera House and bridge in one frame. Sunset about 17:52.

act_aline_birthday.title: Aline's birthday dinner - Aria
act_aline_birthday.notes: The point of the day. Alternatives sit in Ideas if Aria does not work out.

act_dfo.title: DFO Homebush
act_dfo.notes: The long shopping session of the trip - outlet prices, so leave suitcase room.

act_featherdale.title: Featherdale Wildlife Park
act_featherdale.notes: Hand-feeding kangaroos and wallabies, koalas up close. Last entry is about an hour before close.

act_harts.title: Harts Pub
act_harts.notes: Harts is in The Rocks, a fair way from Chinatown. Keep it only if you want the detour - otherwise head straight to Haymarket.

act_chinatown_dinner.title: Malaysian dinner in Chinatown
act_chinatown_dinner.notes: Mamak on Goulburn St queues from about 18:00 and takes no bookings. Ho Jiak and the Dixon St food courts are the fallbacks.

act_wild_play.title: Ian Potter Children's WILD PLAY Garden
act_wild_play.notes: Free. Water play, a bamboo forest and a dry creek bed - bring spare clothes.

act_quadricycle.title: Family quadricycle
act_quadricycle.notes: Hire is inside the park near the Cafe. Four-seaters with a child seat.

act_paddington.title: Paddington - Oxford St and the terraces

act_paddington_markets.title: Paddington Markets
act_paddington_markets.notes: Saturdays only, 10:00-16:00 - this is the one Saturday of the trip that lands here.

act_newtown_1.title: Newtown - King St and the street art
act_newtown_1.notes: The inner-west leg. Drop it without guilt if the day has already been long.

act_tulloch.title: Tulloch Wines - tasting
act_tulloch.notes: Book the Junior Tasting Experience for the little one at the same time as the adults' tasting - it is a grape-juice flight run alongside.

act_audrey.title: Audrey Wilkinson - views
act_audrey.notes: The view down the valley from the terrace is the reason to come. Late light is best.

act_art_gallery.title: Art Gallery of NSW
act_art_gallery.notes: Free general entry. Naala Badu, the newer north building, holds the contemporary galleries and the Yiribana Gallery of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander art - that is the part worth the time.

act_five_ways.title: Paddington - Victorian terraces and Five Ways

act_paddys.title: Paddy's Markets - souvenirs
act_paddys.notes: Haymarket trades Wednesday to Sunday, so it is shut on this Monday - the checks panel flags it. Move it to Day 6 (Friday, before the Chinatown dinner) or Day 12 (Thursday afternoon).

act_echo_point.title: Echo Point + Three Sisters
act_echo_point.notes: Exposed and windy. This is where the jackets earn their place in the bag.

act_scenic_world.title: Scenic World - Railway, Cableway, Skyway
act_scenic_world.notes: The Railway is the steepest passenger railway in the world; the valley boardwalk links the two ends.

act_cliff_walk.title: Prince Henry Cliff Walk
act_cliff_walk.notes: Scenic World back to Echo Point along the clifftop, about 45 minutes, pram-unfriendly in places.

act_sky_safari.title: Sky Safari cable car to the top gate
act_sky_safari.notes: Included with entry. Ride up, then walk the zoo downhill back towards the wharf.

act_balmoral.title: Balmoral Beach
act_balmoral.notes: Harbour beach with a netted swimming enclosure - flat water, no surf.

act_endeavour.title: Endeavour Tap Rooms
act_endeavour.anchorNote: Only if you go back through The Rocks
act_endeavour.notes: It is in The Rocks, a long way back from Balmoral. Easy to skip.

act_bridge_walk.title: Walk across the Sydney Harbour Bridge
act_bridge_walk.notes: Pedestrian path is the eastern side - stairs up from Cumberland St in The Rocks, or the Bridge Stairs at Milsons Point from the north. About 25 minutes each way at a walking pace.

act_pylon.title: Pylon Lookout + Bridge Museum
act_pylon.notes: 200 steps to the top, no lift. Small entry fee, cash not needed.

act_mca_lunch.title: Lunch at the MCA Cafe
act_mca_lunch.notes: Level 4 terrace looks straight at the Opera House.

act_quay_free.title: Circular Quay and the Opera House forecourt

act_opera_tour.title: Sydney Opera House tour
act_opera_tour.notes: The interior was the gap in the original plan. A show would replace this if the calendar allows.

act_claudia_birthday.title: Cláudia's birthday - harbour dinner cruise
act_claudia_birthday.notes: Bridge lit up from the water. Boarding is usually 20 minutes before departure.

act_checkout.title: Check out, leave the bags with the hotel
act_checkout.notes: Confirm the day before that they will hold luggage until the evening.

act_bondi_walk.title: Bondi to Tamarama section
act_bondi_walk.notes: The prettiest stretch, about 25 minutes each way past the Icebergs. The full Bondi-Coogee walk is 6 km and too much on a departure day - it is in Ideas if you would rather trade something for it.

act_newtown_art.title: Newtown street art
act_newtown_art.notes: The I Have a Dream mural is on the wall by Newtown station; the lanes off King St have the rest.

act_the_gap.title: The Gap + South Head
act_the_gap.notes: Ocean cliffs on one side, harbour on the other. Hornby Lighthouse is 20 minutes further out.

act_doyles.title: Doyles - fish and chips by the water
act_doyles.notes: Sunset about 18:32 over the city skyline. The takeaway kiosk by the wharf is the cheaper version.

act_depart.title: Departure flight
act_depart.notes: International check-in closes 60-90 minutes before departure. If this flight leaves before about 21:00, cut Watsons Bay and go straight to the airport after Newtown.

idea_pebbly.title: Pebbly Beach - kangaroos on the sand
idea_pebbly.description: Murramarang National Park, south coast. Wild eastern grey kangaroos on the beach.
idea_pebbly.notes: About 275 km and three and a half hours each way - a whole day for one sight, and the least defensible of the three swaps. Only worth it if wild kangaroos in a natural setting are a priority; Featherdale already covers hand-feeding.

idea_royal_np.title: Royal National Park day
idea_royal_np.description: Audley, Wattamolla and the coast track. The second national park in the world.
idea_royal_np.notes: About an hour each way. The best swap for Day 7 if you would rather have bush and coast than another set of neighbourhoods. Figure Eight Pools only at low tide and only in a small swell - check the NPWS safety page the morning of, people get hurt there.

idea_northern_beaches.title: Palm Beach + Barrenjoey Lighthouse
idea_northern_beaches.description: Palm Beach, the Barrenjoey headland, then Whale Beach and Avalon on the way back.
idea_northern_beaches.notes: The strongest of the three optional swaps and the intended replacement for Day 7. About 75 minutes by car, no train. The lighthouse track is 30-40 minutes up and steep - a carrier for the little one.

idea_barrenjoey.title: Barrenjoey Lighthouse track
idea_barrenjoey.notes: Part of the Northern Beaches day. Smugglers Track is steeper and shorter; Access Trail is easier.

idea_spit_walk.title: Manly to Spit Bridge walk
idea_spit_walk.description: 10 km harbour walk through Dobroyd Head with Aboriginal engravings on the way.
idea_spit_walk.notes: Walk it Spit-to-Manly and finish with the ferry. Too long with a small child unless someone carries.

idea_bondi_coogee.title: Full Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
idea_bondi_coogee.notes: 6 km, two hours at a stroll, no shade. Day 13 has the Bondi-Tamarama section instead.

idea_bridgeclimb.title: BridgeClimb
idea_bridgeclimb.notes: The alternative to the Day 12 walk plus Pylon Lookout. Minimum age is 8 for the Sydney Climb, so check before booking. Dawn and twilight slots cost more and are worth it.

idea_sydney_uni.title: University of Sydney Quadrangle
idea_sydney_uni.notes: Ten minutes from Newtown or Glebe - easy to bolt onto either. Sandstone gothic, free to walk in.

idea_o_bar.title: O Bar and Dining
idea_o_bar.notes: Birthday alternative. Revolving restaurant on level 47 - a full turn takes about 90 minutes.

idea_infinity.title: Infinity at Sydney Tower
idea_infinity.notes: Birthday alternative, and it pairs with the Day 3 tower visit if you would rather double up.

idea_bennelong.title: Bennelong at the Opera House
idea_bennelong.notes: Birthday alternative - inside the smaller shell. Books out furthest ahead of the three.

idea_clearview.title: Clearview glass boat cruise
idea_clearview.notes: Birthday alternative to the Captain Cook cruise - glass roof, so better on a clear night.

idea_opera_show.title: Performance at the Opera House
idea_opera_show.notes: Check the calendar for the trip dates. A family-friendly matinee or an early evening show would replace the Day 12 tour outright.

loc_wild_play.name: Ian Potter Children's WILD PLAY Garden

stay_sydney.name: Sydney base - to be confirmed
stay_sydney.notes: Placeholder so the nightly accommodation check passes. Replace the name, address, phone and booking reference once it is confirmed - no coordinates yet, so nothing is pinned on the map.

trn_arrive.notes: Fill in carrier, flight number and landing time - the rest of Day 1 hangs off it.

trn_transfer_in.notes: Airport Link train is 13 minutes to the CBD but adds a station access fee of about $17 per adult; with luggage and a child a maxi taxi or rideshare often works out similar.

trn_ferry_manly_out.notes: F1 Manly, about 30 minutes. Opal or contactless - tap on and off.

trn_ferry_manly_back.notes: Golden hour on the way back if you catch this one.

trn_drive_dfo.notes: About 20 km west. Paid parking on site.

trn_drive_back.notes: Friday afternoon on the M4 - allow more than the map says.

trn_drive_hunter.notes: About 160 km, two hours via the M1. Clocks went forward at 02:00 - leave earlier than it feels.

trn_drive_hunter_back.notes: Two hours. Whoever drove out should not be the one tasting.

trn_train_katoomba.notes: Blue Mountains line, about two hours. Check the timetable the night before - services are hourly.

trn_bus_echo.notes: The 686 local bus, or the hop-on Explorer Bus if you want Scenic World on the same ticket.

trn_ferry_taronga.notes: About 12 minutes. Zoo-and-ferry combo tickets exist - compare before buying entry separately.

trn_to_balmoral.notes: The 238 from Bradleys Head Rd, or a short taxi - about 4 km.

trn_ferry_watsons.notes: About 25 minutes. Check the last return service before you board - they thin out in the evening.

trn_transfer_out.notes: 30-45 minutes depending on traffic. Pre-book a maxi taxi if there are more than four of you.

trn_depart.notes: Fill in the real flight number and time - the whole shape of Day 13 depends on it.

bkg_stay.notes: Accommodation is not booked yet. Somewhere near Circular Quay, Darling Harbour or Surry Hills keeps most of this itinerary walkable; the Blue Mountains and Hunter days both start from Central or a car park.

bkg_flights.notes: Add both flight numbers and the real times.

bkg_merlin.notes: One multi-attraction pass covers SEA LIFE, WILD LIFE and the Sydney Tower Eye (Day 3). Book online for timed entry - this is the middle of the NSW school holidays.

bkg_aria.notes: Not booked. Fine dining over the Opera House - book weeks ahead and confirm the policy on children. O Bar, Infinity and Bennelong are in Ideas as alternatives.

bkg_featherdale.notes: Not booked. Online tickets only in peak periods; koala photo sessions run to a timetable.

bkg_the_wood.notes: Not booked. Sunday lunch in the valley books out weeks ahead - reserve this before anything else on this day. Book the cellar-door tastings at the same time.

bkg_scenic.notes: Not booked. Timed online tickets are cheaper and skip the queue. The Skyway closes in high wind - they publish conditions each morning.

bkg_taronga.notes: Not booked. Online tickets are dated. Keeper talks and the seal show run to a published timetable - plan the morning around one or two of them.

bkg_bathers.notes: Not booked. There is a formal restaurant and a more relaxed cafe next door - the cafe is the one that works with a child at this hour.

bkg_opera.notes: Not booked. The one-hour building tour runs through the day. If something family-friendly is on in the Concert Hall that evening, a performance is the better birthday version - check the calendar first.

bkg_cruise.notes: Not booked. Alternatives in Ideas: the Clearview glass boat, Bennelong at the Opera House, or an Opera House performance. Whichever it is, book early - peak school-holiday week.
